why: Ticket 1029, second tests round, in next/: the 53 test files in the plan's Files table (62 calls) moved off hand-opened SQLite, 47 to TestDatabase.make and 6 to TestDatabase.open, with reopens through ScopedRef. The rule fabrika/test-database is on and the tree is at zero. Every moved file ran green once at the fast depth. Plants: the rule switched off turned the wiring scenario red; a hand-opened line put back turned the zero-tree scenario red; WAL in place of MEMORY in make left Sink green, so the plan's guess that Sink would go red was wrong (its laws check bytes never written). Measured at full depth, three runs each, median wall: Watchers 216.7 s to 152.4 s, IsolateUsage 18.6 s to 8.1 s; system time fell to 10% and 16% of before, so disk syncs were the cost.
note: Three fabrika/no-effect-run-outside-edge disables were added in two test kits whose callers are plain functions; the review judged them. No run rows were written for the plan, the first tests round and the build of this ticket; their numbers are not recorded.
